candidate-conflict-repair.title: Prepare conflict repair
candidate-conflict-repair.intro: Create a separate repair task from this recorded conflict. Its candidate requires independent tests and explicit review.
candidate-conflict-repair.original_faile: The original composition failed with a source conflict. This fact remains unchanged.
candidate-conflict-repair.eligible: Current facts allow a repair preview. Creation rechecks the fixed sources, authority and tool.
candidate-conflict-repair.blocked: Preparing another repair is unavailable under the current facts. The original conflict remains readable.
candidate-conflict-repair.refresh_previe: Explicitly recheck this same task, conflict, sources, tool and route, then extend the ready preview. This does not change its definition, create a task or start a run.
candidate-conflict-repair.refresh_reason: Reason for extending the fixed preview
candidate-conflict-repair.criteria_help: One criterion per line, up to 16. The repair must preserve every fixed source and pass its own independent tests.
candidate-conflict-repair.unassigned: Follow current account when uniquely matched
candidate-conflict-repair.choose_workflo: Choose a workflow with independent tests
candidate-conflict-repair.tool_help: Only a currently available native tool with an explicit administrator conflict-repair capability can run this repair.
candidate-conflict-repair.codex_blocked: Codex does not support the required repair workspace
candidate-conflict-repair.create_help: This creates one new task and its fixed preview. Review that preview and separately confirm Start; creation does not launch a run.
candidate-conflict-repair.created_help: Open this exact task to inspect the fixed preview, explicitly start repair, then review its own candidate and independent tests.
candidate-conflict-repair.recovery: The create response is uncertain. Restore the original request and operation key to locate its task; do not create another repair.
candidate-conflict-repair.invalid_read: The response does not match this project's fixed conflict or separate repair task.
candidate-conflict-repair.refresh_failed: Current repair facts could not be read. Your draft is retained; refresh before confirming again.
candidate-conflict-repair.plan_boundary: This is a separate repair task and candidate. The original failed composition and its ordered sources remain fixed.
candidate-conflict-repair.start_help: Start creates one repair run using the fixed native tool. The workflow independently tests its new candidate; formal review remains separate.
candidate-conflict-repair.start_ack: I reviewed the original conflict, all ordered sources and this fixed tool, and authorize one repair run with independent tests.
candidate-conflict-repair.open_repair_ru: Open actual repair and test run
candidate-conflict-repair.accepted_help: This repair task is formally accepted. Target integration and downstream baseline binding remain separate explicit actions.
candidate-conflict-repair.evidence_bound: Recorded repair steps and code inputs do not replace independent tests, human review or target integration receipts.
candidate-conflict-repair.evidence_inval: The repair facts do not match this workspace. Inspect the original run; successful repair is not inferred.
candidate-conflict-repair.local_checks_h: Comma-separated IDs already defined in the same local commands file. These development checks do not replace independent workflow tests.
candidate-conflict-repair.local_opt_in: Allow governed conflict repair in this local template
candidate-conflict-repair.local_policy: This edits the displayed local configuration template only. The Runner administrator must install the exact runtime and manifest, apply the file, and probe/import the advertised capability before enabling it. No Runner policy changes in the browser.
candidate-conflict-repair.capability: The probed native profile advertises governed conflict repair. Availability and current authority are rechecked on each use.
candidate-conflict-repair.reason.missing: The original run has no complete native Git conflict evidence. A path list alone cannot authorize repair.
candidate-conflict-repair.reason.changed: The fixed conflict basis or repair plan changed. Read the current facts before creating a preview.
candidate-conflict-repair.reason.tool: Select a current, explicitly enabled native conflict-repair tool.
candidate-conflict-repair.reason.reserve: This repair task is reserved for its fixed composition plan. Open that plan to start it.
candidate-conflict-repair.reason.invalid: The conflict-repair request is invalid. Check the task, criteria and fixed selections.
